subject: POC MAP: sprint-trigger — preflight checklist for access & networking
messages:
From: Erin Hooper <erin.hooper@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 5 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC MAP: preflight and access gating

Diego / team —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Jordan and I reviewed the Redwood MAP template you shared and we want to lock in the preflight gating items so our security team can start the checklist. High level asks from our side:

- Org + tenant setup: need guidance on the minimal org/tenant config for a trial (RBAC, billing placeholders).
- API keys: request tempo-limited API key for evaluation; preference for ephemeral keys we can rotate.
- IP allowlist: our infra team needs the IP ranges to add to their firewall (we can open ports but will need CIDR list).
- VPC peering: we need a rough timeline for establishing peering and a contact for networking (NAT/NVA considerations).

Can you propose a short checklist with owners and target dates? We are aiming for a light-weight POC that starts next Tuesday (2028-05-09) if gating is green.

I've attached our security questionnaire (short form) — please return the filled sections for infra/network where applicable.

Thanks,
Erin
Erin Hooper
Director, Platform Engineering
ClearPath Health
Attachment: clearpath-security-q.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Hooper <erin.hooper@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 May 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC MAP: preflight and access gating

Thanks Erin — this is great context.

I've sketched a sprint-trigger style MAP below (short, owner-oriented) to make it actionable for both teams. I attached a filled MAP template (redwood-map-template.xlsx) with a proposed schedule. Please review and comment.

POC MAP (high level) — owners and target dates
1) Org + tenant provisioning — owner: Diego Fernandez — target: 2028-05-06 T17:00 PDT
   - Create trial tenant, configure two roles (admin, dev-readonly), and add ClearPath contact.
   - Deliverable: tenant ID + access matrix.

2) API keys & ephemeral key guidance — owner: Ben Carter — target: 2028-05-06 T20:00 PDT
   - Issue a scoped, time-limited API key (14-day) for eval traffic.
   - Provide rotation instructions and how to request extension.

3) IP allowlist & firewall entries — owner: Neha Kapoor — target: 2028-05-07 T12:00 PDT
   - Provide exact CIDRs to add: 34.210.128.0/20, 52.12.64.0/18, 3.208.45.12/32 (control plane endpoint), and Egress ranges for streaming: 18.204.0.0/16.
   - Provide path for temporary whitelisting for test windows.

4) VPC peering & network handoff — owner: Neha Kapoor — target: 2028-05-08 T18:00 PDT
   - Pre-check: customer provides ASN and VPC CIDR blocks.
   - We will provide step-by-step peering template and a small runbook for routing/NAT issues.

5) Security artifacts & evidence — owner: Diego Fernandez — target: 2028-05-07 T15:00 PDT
   - Return the redacted SOC/attestation page and fill the ClearPath questionnaire sections related to connectivity and data handling.

Next steps and asks for ClearPath
- Confirm that the proposed dates above are OK (especially IP allowlist window target: 2028-05-07).
- Share VPC CIDRs + preferred peering contact for the ticket.
- Confirm whether dev team needs a sandbox API key earlier for test scripts (we can issue one for 48 hours).

Attachments:
- redwood-map-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet) — MAP with granular tasks.

If you want, we can run a 20-minute preflight call Monday morning (2028-05-08) to unblock the network team.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Erin Hooper <erin.hooper@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 6 May 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC MAP: sprint-trigger — preflight checklist for access & networking

Diego — thanks for the rapid turnaround and the clear owner map. That schedule looks workable. A few clarifications:

- CIDRs: we will accept the listed control plane / streaming IPs; I'll confirm with infra if they need a specific /28 instead of a /20 on our side (we try to be conservative).
- VPC peering: Jordan will be our networking contact — he will send ASN + CIDR tomorrow.
- API key: we'd like the 48-hour sandbox key now so our QA can smoke-test scripts this afternoon.

We will schedule the 20-min preflight on Monday 2028-05-08 at 09:00 PDT if that works for you and Neha.

Attached: our filled security questionnaire (network sections completed) — see "Section 2: Connectivity".

Erin
Erin Hooper
Director, Platform Engineering
ClearPath Health
Attachment: clearpath-security-q.pdf (application/pdf)

On Fri, May 5, 2028 at 9:15 AM Erin Hooper <erin.hooper@clearpathhealth.com> wrote:
> Diego / team —
> 
> Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning....
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Hooper <erin.hooper@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 6 May 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC MAP: sprint-trigger — preflight checklist for access & networking

Perfect — thanks for the confirmations and for filling Section 2.

Action items (finalized):
- Diego: create tenant and send tenant ID + access matrix (due 2028-05-06 17:00 PDT) — COMPLETED, tenant ID: rwd-poc-cph-002 (I will send separate secure note with owner credentials).
- Ben: issue 48-hour sandbox API key (due 2028-05-05 18:00 PDT) — COMPLETED, key issued and sent via Vault link.
- Neha: publish final CIDR list and peering template; start peering ticket once Jordan shares ASN/CIDR (due 2028-05-07 12:00 PDT).
- ClearPath (Erin/Jordan): share VPC CIDR + peering contact and confirm firewall window for 2028-05-07.

Networking quick info (Neha / infra):
- Control plane endpoint (TLS): 3.208.45.12/32
- Public API egress ranges: 34.210.128.0/20, 52.12.64.0/18, 18.204.0.0/16
- Peering notes: allow BGP sessions; MTU 1500; we recommend no overlapping CIDRs.

I'll put the MAP into HubSpot (HSP-45672) and attach the template we discussed.

If anything changes before Monday, flag here and we'll reroute. Otherwise see you at the preflight call 2028-05-08 09:00 PDT.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
